summary: Refactored the session tree screen header to a panel layout with a new 'Fork' button (disabled while branching) and a screen-reader summary of the current path. Updated corresponding CSS in resize-and-navigation.css and session-tree.css, replacing the old tree-screen/tree-header structure with tree-panel/tree-header-inner/tree-controls classes, then inspected the agent event reducer's messageCount handling.
decisions: Replaced the 'Run' button label with 'Fork' and added `|| branching` to its disabled condition so a fork cannot be triggered mid-branch.
Restructured the tree header into a panel-style header (tree-header-inner, tree-search, tree-controls, summary element) instead of reusing the settings-back pattern.
Wrapped the tree body in a new <section data-ui="tree-panel"> with width capped at 980px and rounded border/shadow, and named the ScrollPanel 'session-tree'.
Extracted the inline edit action row into [data-ui='tree-editor'] styles (textarea min-height 100px, vertically resizable, right-aligned actions).
